summary: Measure every held collection window under load with an opt-in daemon_load profile

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Only the load test changes. ST_LOAD_PROFILE=collections-v1 has each of its 22 subscribers also hold missions, work, attention, summary, glasses and arrangements windows, each first snapshot timed against the roster's 300 ms budget. The default agents-v1 workload is unchanged, and a report compares only with baselines of its own profile.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover; the daemon is unchanged.
